_comment: Schema for build_peer_workbook.py. ALL NUMBERS BELOW ARE ILLUSTRATIVE - real results.json holds store cost data and stays in the scratchpad, never committed. Store keys are manifest keys; Division values are Qlik Division names.
findings: Lead finding in plain language (shown numbered on the Summary tab).
_labor_gross_per_ro: Optional. Omit/null to use the target's diagnostic/general-repair labor gross per RO from jobs.

basket._comment: From the basket bundle. rows = [band, Lines, ROs, Actual, Cost, List, target matrix, peer1 matrix, peer2 ...] in --stores order. lines_below/above_own from the scenarios bundle.

scenarios._comment: From the scenarios bundle: ROs, Mid_<peer>, Cap_<peer> per peer.

jobs._comment: rows straight from the jobs bundle: [Division, Job, Lines, ROs, PartsSale, PartsCost, LaborSale, LaborCost]. cp_ros from the cpros bundle (current period).

broad._comment: Optional. Per Division [CP ROs (cpros), ROs50, PartsSale, PartsCost (broad)] for prior and current year.

pricepos._comment: Optional. From the pricepos bundle: bucket -> store key -> [sale, list, cost].

same_part._comment: Optional. index rows = [peer key, index, matched parts, target $ covered]. Table rows = [part, description, target, peer1, ..., list] (null = not sold).
same_part.subtitle: October 2026

traffic._comment: Optional. Per Division [prior CP ROs, current CP ROs, prior CP parts $, current CP parts $] from cpros run for each year.

methodology_extra: Any extra methodology note for this run.
